title: Sheriff's Office | Macon-Bibb County
key_finding: The county government identifies the Bibb County Sheriff's Office as the active law-enforcement surface for police reports, crime reports, and accident reports.

title: Court Information | Municipal Court of Macon-Bibb County
key_finding: The court page states that House Bill 1171 consolidated the governments of the City of Macon and Bibb County effective January 1, 2014 and that the Municipal Court of Macon-Bibb County has jurisdiction over traffic offenses and code violations occurring in Macon-Bibb County.

title: 2020 Annual Budget Introduction
key_finding: The budget introduction states that the Bibb County Sheriff's Office merged with the Macon Police Department in January 2014.

title: 2023 Annual Budget
key_finding: Later Macon-Bibb budget materials continue to describe the Sheriff's Office as the merged successor to the Macon Police Department.

title: County launches new efforts to increase number of deputies on patrol
key_finding: Official county news discusses increasing the number of deputies on patrol throughout the county, consistent with sheriff-led consolidated policing.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
